summary: Re-tested iteration_81 vendor navbar overlap bug. Verified overlap fix using bounding-box intersection of all [data-testid] elements inside <nav> for VENDOR/EMPLOYEE/ADMIN across 1920, 1440, 1280, 1200, 1024, 390. VENDOR now shows the full horizontal nav at 1280 (>=xl) with ZERO overlaps and no horizontal overflow; at 1200/1024/390 the vendor horizontal nav is hidden and the hamburger + drawer render (drawer opens with grouped links). EMPLOYEE and ADMIN pass with no overlap/overflow at 1920 and 1280; employee 'More' dropdown opens with Team Order/Events/Rewards/Feedback; admin grouped nav (network/operations/insights/system) opens cleanly. Mobile 390 has no horizontal overflow for all three roles.

rca of the issue: Previous overlap at vendor 1280 was caused by heavy right cluster (outlet switcher + alerts pill + role + bell + logout) competing with full horizontal nav at lg. Fix: raise vendor desktop nav breakpoint from lg to xl (hidden xl:flex) and hide employee-only extras (nav-change-password/nav-data-privacy) until xl. At 1280 the vendor horizontal nav now renders with no rect intersections; below 1280 vendor falls to the mobile hamburger + drawer.
